title: nan
authors: Jiang J.; Zhang T.; Li K.
key_contribution: Presents a systematic experimental evaluation of 15 3D LiDAR SLAM methods for autonomous navigation in GNSS-denied stacked-cage farming houses, with quantitative positioning and mapping accuracy results.
